evidence.quote: the FOMC decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by a ¼ percentage point to 3¾ to 4 percent
The plain fact is that inflation is too high and has been for too long.
Our decision comes at a time when the American economy appears to be strengthening.
Inflation risks are to the upside while labor risks are roughly balanced.
Today’s action starts to show we’re serious about this.
I’m not going to prejudge any future decisions we make.
